snippet.title: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The fight finally makes its way to Steam!

Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. arrives on January 28, 2025!
Join the Open Beta now + Pre-order to get 20% off!

Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O takes Virtua Fighter 5 Ultimate Showdown to the next level!

Rollback netcode is finally here—letting players experience smoother and more in-depth battles with opponents from all over the world. In addition, R.E.V.O. brings a variety of balance adjustments, 4K resolution support, new moves and combos and more!

Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. Official Site:
https://sega.com/virtua-fighter/virtua-fighter-5-revo
#VF #VF5REVO #VirtuaFighter
